## Checkpoint 3 Q3
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
Screen_Time_and_Time_Spent_Studying <- read_excel("~/DATA 211/Excel Files/Screen Time and Time Spent Studying.xlsx")
View(Screen_Time_and_Time_Spent_Studying)
```

```{r}
ggplot(data=Screen_Time_and_Time_Spent_Studying,aes(x=Screen_Time,y=Time_Spent_Studying))+
  geom_point(color="red")+
  geom_smooth(method="lm",se=TRUE,linetype="dashed")+
  labs(x="Screen Time",y="Time Spent Studying",title="Relationship between Screen Time and Time Spent Studying")
```
